visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts at an airport terminal. A woman with bright pink hair tied in buns and a man with short black hair stand together. The woman holds two green passports and a selfie stick while winking at the camera. They wear casual clothes: she in a white crop top and dark jeans, he in a white t-shirt and blue jeans with a red backpack. (2) A rapid series of cuts follows. They are seen sitting on an airport train, then standing by a wall with large 'Hong Kong' text. The woman wears a blue Adidas jacket over her white top in some shots. (3) They visit various iconic Hong Kong spots. They pose in front of a red tiled wall at Central station, inside a crowded traditional tea house where the camera spins, and at a street food stall holding a tray of egg waffles. (4) The setting shifts to Hong Kong Disneyland. They wear colorful outfits and character headbands, posing in front of the main gate and with a large mascot of the turtle character Olu Mel. Night shots show them spinning rapidly with the Disney castle fireworks in the background. (5) They pose on the cobblestone steps of Pottinger Street, the man in a pink shirt and the woman in her blue jacket. (6) The final shot is inside an airplane cabin. The woman rests her head on the man's shoulder while both have their eyes closed, appearing to sleep during the flight back home.
